availableCommands.name: cloudflare-email-service
availableCommands.description: Send and receive transactional emails with Cloudflare Email Service (Email Sending + Email Routing). Use when building email sending (Workers binding or REST API), email routing, Agents SDK email handling, or integrating email into any app — Workers, Node.js, Python, Go, etc. Also use for email deliverability, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, wrangler email setup, MCP email tools, or when a coding agent needs to send emails. availableCommands.name: cloudflare-one-migrations

availableCommands.name: durable-objects

Covers Workers integration, wrangler config, and testing with Vitest. Biases towards retrieval from Cloudflare docs over pre-trained knowledge.

availableCommands.name: run-workflow
availableCommands.description: How to write and run a dynamic workflow script with the `run_workflow` tool: a Python script that orchestrates many agents with `agent`, `parallel`, `pipeline`, and `phase`. Use when a task splits into many independent or staged pieces of agent work (fan out over files, modules, bugs, or review angles, then aggregate), or when the user asks for a workflow. Don't use for a single delegated task (use a subagent) or for legacy workflow files (see migrate-workflows).

availableCommands.description: Use when porting a Cloudflare Sandbox app from stable @cloudflare/sandbox to @cloudflare/sandbox@next (Sandbox SDK 1.0 preview), or when the user asks to migrate or upgrade to Sandbox 1.0 / @next. Not for day-to-day stable work (sandbox-stable) or new @next apps (sandbox-next).

availableCommands.name: sandbox-next

availableCommands.name: sandbox-stable

availableCommands.name: swarm
availableCommands.description: (Preview & Quota Heavy) Run a swarm: several agents working in parallel on one task, each in its own conversation, collaborating through a shared message board. availableCommands.name: turnstile-spin
availableCommands.description: Set up Cloudflare Turnstile end-to-end in a project. res = await agent(
    prompt="カレントディレクトリにある w.txt に「w」とだけ書き込んでください。書き込みが完了したら finish ツールを呼び出してください。",
    schema={"type": "string"},
    role="w-writer",
)
log(f"Done: {res}")
